sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fixed the "Length" column's split-align "M:SS" cell text (rendered as three sibling `.mb-ic-left`/`.mb-ic-sep`/`.mb-ic-right` spans) reading as "5 : 05" instead of "5:05" to both the plain-text filter matcher and the highlighter, so a manually-typed column or global filter like "5:0" never matched any row even though the cell visibly shows "5:05". getCleanColumnText()/getCleanVisibleText() now collapse `.mb-ic-wrap` into one opaque text node, and highlightCrossTag() suppresses its own virtual join-gap for text nodes sharing one `.mb-ic-wrap` ancestor, so both stay positionally consistent with what a user actually types.
